description: This file acts as an index module for the Playwright core server package, exporting types, classes, functions, and constants related to browser registry, dispatcher connections, trace viewer, and Playwright instances.

classes.name: DispatcherConnection
classes.description: Handles the connection to dispatcher objects, facilitating communication in the server architecture.

classes.name: RootDispatcher
classes.description: Serves as the root dispatcher managing various sub-dispatchers and overall communication.

classes.name: PlaywrightDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher responsible for managing Playwright-specific commands and routes.

methods.name: installBrowsersForNpmInstall
methods.description: Installs browser binaries in the context of npm install.

methods.name: registry
methods.description: Provides access to the registry object.

methods.name: registryDirectory
methods.description: Returns the directory path of the registry.

methods.name: writeDockerVersion
methods.description: Writes the current Docker version info.

methods.name: createPlaywright
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Playwright instance.

methods.name: installRootRedirect
methods.description: Sets up redirection from root to the main application or interface.

methods.name: openTraceInBrowser
methods.description: Opens a trace file or URL in a web browser.

methods.name: openTraceViewerApp
methods.description: Launches the trace viewer application to analyze traces.

methods.name: runTraceViewerApp
methods.description: Runs the trace viewer application as a process.

methods.name: startTraceViewerServer
methods.description: Starts the trace viewer server for remote access.
